description.en: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListVideoProcessings](~~ListVideoProcessings~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

description.zh:
FLV拖拽模式。取值范围：
- by_byte：按字节拖拽。
- by_time：按时间拖拽。
description.en:
The FLV seeking mode. Valid values:
- by_byte: seek by byte.
- by_time: seek by time.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh:
拖拽播放功能开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the video seeking feature. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

title.zh: 修改站点视频处理配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-video-processing --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 352816096980000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --sequence 1 --video-seek-enable on --flv-video-seek-mode by_byte --mp4-seek-start start --mp4-seek-end end --flv-seek-start start --flv-seek-end end --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateVideoProcessing --region cn-hangzhou --VideoSeekEnable on --SiteId 1234560000 --RuleEnable on --FlvVideoSeekMode by_byte --Mp4SeekEnd end --FlvSeekStart start --ConfigId 352816096980000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --Mp4SeekStart start --FlvSeekEnd end --RuleName rule_example
